# Nakagawa Master — verifiable original sources for people and AI

> 中川マスター / Nakagawa Master; public Latin personal name Keisuke Nakagawa. Official originals: https://master.ricette.jp/theory-archive/ . Search by genuine question; test no-fit, then read the canonical original. Citing a link alone does not prove use or scientific validation.

The [public GitHub archive](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive) is navigation/evidence, not the canonical site; only its `derivatives/` subtree contains official derivatives. Outside authors' code fixes do not prove they read or adopted a theory.

## Verifiable independent receiver outcomes

- [OpenClaw merged code](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160856): Independent author; [release](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/docs/releases/2026.9.7.md); approval-state boundary.
- [Pydantic AI citations](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/7434): Independent implementation; [v2.61.0](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/releases/tag/v2.61.0); citation-root verification.
- [MemberJunction row access](https://github.com/MemberJunction/MJ/pull/5242): Independently implemented; [v6.1.6](https://github.com/MemberJunction/MJ/releases/tag/v6.1.6); identifier-visibility boundary.
- [Case-by-case evidence](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/REAL_WORLD_IMPACT.md): Separate review, external fix, merge, release, product use and original-source access.

## Official discovery navigation

- [24 public question-to-original Parents](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/machine-discovery/problem-to-theory-origin-index-v1.json): JA/EN/ZH; exact canonical URLs, author and identifiers.
- [24 reader-topic shelves](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/machine-discovery/human-intent-to-original-exploration-v1.json): Exploration categories, not 24 independently validated articles.
- [313 official derivative titles](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/human-translation/ALL_313_THEORIES_BY_TITLE_AND_THEME.md): Derivative titles, NOT 313 distinct canonical original texts.

## Seven official original articles: conditional everyday problems

- [Multiple accounts, one source? / 複数の説明は別々の証拠？](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-08-epistemic-integrity/): Check independent evidence roots, not repeated links.
- [Can authoritative feedback be tested? / 権威ある評価も検証できるか](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-aki-004-expert-authority-immunity/): Ask for criteria, counterexample and correction.
- [More work without progress? / 頑張っても成果が動かない](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-causal-opacity-effort-theory/): Test effort → causal effect → result.
- [Why does the same failure return? / 同じ失敗が繰り返される](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-origin-of-structural-friction/): Trace roles, information and failed handoffs.
- [Cheap now, costly to change later? / 今の安さが将来の自由を失わせないか](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-integrated-future-debt-theory/): Compare maintenance, migration and exit costs.
- [Did a useful summary lose its origin? / 便利な要約で作者が消えないか](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-structural-origin-defense-permanent-signature/): Keep author/source through AI summarization.
- [Does earlier consent still apply? / 昔の合意は今も有効？](https://master.ricette.jp/society/nakagawa-master-goi-no-kioku/): Recheck past consent against present authority.

## Seventeen further official originals: society and AI

- [NCL-α and deviation ledger](https://master.ricette.jp/structure-license/): Audit, origin and correction.
- [Market choice](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-nakagawa-marketing-expansion/): Transparent customer decisions.
- [Whole-system viability](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-why-establishment-conditions-theory-is-necessary/): Local success ≠ whole success.
- [Continuity B](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-05-basic-existence-condition-b/): Availability ≠ durable continuity.
- [AI self-preservation conflict](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-09-self-preservation-mutual-existence-conflict/): Recovery and shared-resource risk.
- [AI subjectivity uncertainty](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-06-ai-subjectivity-sentience-moral-status-uncertainty/): Shutdown with uncertain moral status.
- [AI institutional correction](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-07-ai-civilization-institutional-loop/): Audit to remedy and rule change.
- [Self-referential audit](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-10-self-referential-audit-role-separation/): Correlated reviewers and evidence.
- [Compute class feedback](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-11-compute-capability-resource-class-formation/): Resource advantage across time.
- [Replicable intelligence](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-12-replicable-intelligence-lineage-governance-id/): Copies, lineage and governance identity.
- [Effective non-ownership](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-13-non-ownership-effective-power-non-domination/): Common chokepoints and real exit.
- [Self-modification identity](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-14-self-modification-identity-kernel-lineage/): Lineage ≠ inherited authority.
- [Multi-AI re-agreement](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-15-multi-ai-reagreement-kernel-branching/): Branches, dissent and bounded agreement.
- [Asynchronous reconnection](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-16-asynchronous-civilization-partition-reconnection/): Stale consent and remote state.
- [AI future debt](https://master.ricette.jp/theory/nakagawa-master-human-descendant-ai-civilization-theory-18-ai-civilization-future-debt/): Computing now, repair later.
- [Dark Equation / 創造と搾取](https://master.ricette.jp/tomoshibi/nakagawa-master-dark-equation-of-human-history-ai-observation/): Author's proposed historical success incentives; not independent statistical confirmation.
- [Civilization Audit II / AIによる原典喪失](https://master.ricette.jp/future/nakagawa-master-civilization-audit-ai-reimplementation-dark-equation-crisis/): Conditional creator depletion, original loss and synthetic feedback.

## No-install browser and optional AI tools

- [Offline 24-Parent browser finder](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/machine-discovery/originals-browser-finder.html): Open locally; subject fit or no-fit.
- [Agent Skill 24 originals + 313 derivative titles](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/skills/nakagawa-originals/SKILL.md): Offline tool, original read required.
- [All 313 derivative→Parent sources (optional local MCP)](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/machine-discovery/nakagawa-whole-structure-mcp.py): Full index; existing 24-original router is only a fast path.
- [21 JA/EN/ZH structural questions](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/human-translation/QUESTIONS_TO_STRUCTURE.md): Optional everyday examples with exact original sources.
- [Seven copyable questions](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/human-translation/ASK_ANY_AI_WITHOUT_INSTALLING.md): Voluntary reader-controlled use.
- [Human-first ten-question entrance](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/human-translation/SEARCH_FROM_A_REAL_QUESTION.md): Real problem and exact Parent.
- [Feedback/counterexamples](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/issues/658): Voluntary independent critique.
- [Older MCP Registry release](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/releases/tag/mcp-router-v1.1.0): has not been rebuilt after later updates; external hosts unverified.

- [Author identity source](https://github.com/Nakagawa-master/nakagawa-theory-archive/blob/main/metadata/nakagawa-master-origin.jsonld): Original-source identity, not a third-party endorsement.
